comment: Persons Unknown ward graybox fight stills. A live human collects the Shotgun on the upper gallery, sees two seated Clerks in the guard room, clears them, descends the service stair, then fights the ward, floor and dock. There are no switches or gates; two arrivals advance the objectives. Accurate aim is capture evidence, not a difficulty review. Latch is an arrival stand-in. This is not playable M02.

states.name: gallery_arrival
states.note: Arrival on the observation gallery. The ward view and Latch presentation are still graybox work.

states.name: shotgun_discovery
states.note: The guaranteed Shotgun is visible ahead on the upper gallery before it is claimed.

states.name: upper_gallery_loadout
states.note: The player collects the Shotgun and Shells before entering the guard room.

states.name: seated_guard_room
states.note: Two Clerks wait with weapons down at the guard-room table before their encounter activates.

states.name: guard_room_fight
states.note: Both guard-room Clerks defeated after the Shotgun pickup and before the stairs.

states.name: service_stair_descent
states.note: The service stair comes after the Shotgun lesson; its future Crawler encounter is not built yet.

states.name: ward_fight
states.note: The ward after its fight. The Tack is discovered on the approach and selected for the wider room.

states.name: find_latch
states.note: Arrival at the restraint frame, the stand-in for finding Latch.

states.name: floor_fight
states.note: The processing floor after its fight.

states.name: dock_fight
states.note: The loading dock after its fight.

states.name: departed
states.note: Onto the dock: GET OUT is complete and the graybox departs.
